newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to deploy 10,000 soldiers for election.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to deploy 10,000 soldiers for election.

text.p: Indonesia's armed forces will deploy more than 10,000 soldiers to secure the May 29 general election in the capital Jakarta, the official Antara news agency reported on Thursday.
It said the soldiers would guard the capital on polling day together with the police force, adding that the armed forces would also deploy armoured vehicles. It gave no other details.
Three sanctioned parties -- the ruling Golkar, Moslem-oriented United Development Party (PPP) and the Christian-Nationalist Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) -- are contesting the polls.
Campaigning for the 425 seats in the 500 seat parliament is restricted to a 25-day period between April 29 and May 23. A five day cooling-off period separates campaigning and the polling day.
Armed forces members, who do not vote, receive 75 seats.
